title: Reference and three walking styles
caption: All four at the same 0.3 m/s command and side camera. Compare foot angle, step cadence, and crouched posture. The reference is the locked approved walker; this overview is not the matched-control experiment. Each variation has its own paired comparison below and passed the full 50-trial command suite. One successful training seed per style.
head_motion: Cosmetic neck bounce while moving, idle looks, and approximately level forward gaze. Simulated head targets and locomotion unchanged.

title: Command Walking
caption: Recorded instructor command baseline: all 50 speed/backward/stop/turn/transition trials pass. The initial 8000-step run missed drift checks; an unchanged 3000-step continuation recovered them. About 13.4 minutes of combined training on the local L40S, plus setup and evaluation. The curve shown is the recovery stage only. This is the locked reference walker. The three current style variations train from scratch; the recorded course uses the fresh scratch control. One training seed; five perturbed evaluation starts.
head_motion: Cosmetic neck bounce while moving, idle looks, and approximately level forward gaze. Simulated head targets and locomotion unchanged.

title: Scratch training: flatter feet
caption: One changed scalar: level-feet reward 0 → 0.75. Forward swing-foot tilt falls from about 12 to 6 degrees; cadence stays similar. Training: 14m 54s. Both policies train from scratch with seed 7 and 10,000 steps. The variant passes all 50 command trials with zero falls. Same commanded forward speed, normal playback. Local L40S timing; single training seed, actual Colab untested.

title: Scratch training: quicker steps
caption: One reward preset: airborne duration 0.06–0.16 s, weight 4. Forward cadence rises from about 4.3 to 6.7 foot landings/s with shorter steps. Training: 15m 1s, slightly beyond the requested 15-minute limit. Both policies train from scratch with seed 7 and 10,000 steps. The variant passes all 50 command trials with zero falls. Same commanded forward speed, normal playback. Local L40S timing; single training seed, actual Colab untested.

title: Higher hops with softer touchdowns
caption: Earlier versus course-ready hopping at the same forward command. Five perturbed evaluation starts, one training seed. Clear-flight means: 5.9 cm bilateral clearance, 0.16 s airtime, 9.2 degrees sole tilt. Sampled touchdown peaks are about 30% lower; these are 20 ms samples, not substep impact forces. Curve: final 1000-step stage only; full curriculum about 23 minutes training.

caption: Full 25 mm challenge: three obstacles, rough ground, raised finish; 53.56 simulated seconds and zero falls. Visual steering with pauses, not autonomous navigation or real-time human play.

title: Scratch-trained crouched walking
caption: Crouched walking: add a 23 cm torso-height target. Both policies start from scratch with seed 8 and 9000 steps. The crouched policy passes all 50 command trials and lowers the torso by 2.9 cm; foot clearance drops from 3.2 to 1.8 cm. The unchanged control fails forward/fast checks and is not a validated baseline. Selected 9000-step prefix; later training was not better. Local training: 11m 13s for the variant, 12m 12s for its control. One training seed; actual Colab untested.
head_motion: Cosmetic neck bounce while moving, idle looks, and approximately level forward gaze. Simulated head targets and locomotion unchanged.

title: Why hop over this step?
caption: Same 25 mm step and start: walking stalls at both 0.30 and 0.45 m/s commands; hopping crosses. The video shows seed 282. Across three starting seeds, walking crossed 0/6 trials and hopping 3/3. This is an isolated obstacle check, not a full-course run, and does not prove every possible walking controller fails.
